MasulloGRH.genuineZetaXi_analytic (s : ℂ) : AnalyticAt ℂ MasulloGRH.genuineZetaXi s
'MasulloGRH.genuineZetaXi_analytic' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
MasulloGRH.genuineZetaXi_zero : MasulloGRH.genuineZetaXi 0 = 1
'MasulloGRH.genuineZetaXi_zero' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
MasulloGRH.genuineZetaXi_completed (s : ℂ) (h0 : s ≠ 0) (h1 : s ≠ 1) :
  MasulloGRH.genuineZetaXi s = s * (s - 1) * completedRiemannZeta s
'MasulloGRH.genuineZetaXi_completed' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
MasulloGRH.genuineZetaXi_zero_iff_completed (s : ℂ) (h0 : s ≠ 0) (h1 : s ≠ 1) :
  MasulloGRH.genuineZetaXi s = 0 ↔ completedRiemannZeta s = 0
'MasulloGRH.genuineZetaXi_zero_iff_completed' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
MasulloGRH.genuineZetaXi_order_finite (s : ℂ) : analyticOrderAt MasulloGRH.genuineZetaXi s ≠ ⊤
'MasulloGRH.genuineZetaXi_order_finite' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
MasulloGRH.genuineZetaXi_local_factor (s : ℂ) :
  ∃ g,
    AnalyticAt ℂ g s ∧
      g s ≠ 0 ∧ MasulloGRH.genuineZetaXi =ᶠ[𝓝 s] fun z => (z - s) ^ MasulloGRH.genuineZetaMultiplicity s * g z
'MasulloGRH.genuineZetaXi_local_factor' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
MasulloGRH.genuineZetaMultiplicity_pos_iff (s : ℂ) :
  0 < MasulloGRH.genuineZetaMultiplicity s ↔ MasulloGRH.genuineZetaXi s = 0
'MasulloGRH.genuineZetaMultiplicity_pos_iff' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
MasulloGRH.genuineZetaXi_zero_iff_zeta (s : ℂ) (hpos : 0 < s.re) (hlt : s.re < 1) :
  MasulloGRH.genuineZetaXi s = 0 ↔ riemannZeta s = 0
'MasulloGRH.genuineZetaXi_zero_iff_zeta' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
MasulloGRH.genuineZetaXi_zeros_compact_finite (K : Set ℂ) (hK : IsCompact K) :
  {s | s ∈ K ∧ MasulloGRH.genuineZetaXi s = 0}.Finite
'MasulloGRH.genuineZetaXi_zeros_compact_finite' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
MasulloGRH.genuineZeta_zeros_compact_finite (K : Set ℂ) (hK : IsCompact K) :
  {s | s ∈ K ∧ 0 < s.re ∧ s.re < 1 ∧ riemannZeta s = 0}.Finite
'MasulloGRH.genuineZeta_zeros_compact_finite' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
MasulloGRH.genuineZeta_order_eq (s : ℂ) (hpos : 0 < s.re) (hlt : s.re < 1) :
  analyticOrderAt riemannZeta s = analyticOrderAt MasulloGRH.genuineZetaXi s
'MasulloGRH.genuineZeta_order_eq' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
MasulloGRH.genuineZeta_occurrences_finite (K : Set ℂ) (hK : IsCompact K) :
  Finite ((s : { s // s ∈ K ∧ 0 < s.re ∧ s.re < 1 ∧ riemannZeta s = 0 }) × Fin (MasulloGRH.genuineZetaMultiplicity ↑s))
'MasulloGRH.genuineZeta_occurrences_finite' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
MasulloGRH.genuineNormTwistZeta_zeros_compact_finite (t : ℝ) (K : Set ℂ) (hK : IsCompact K) :
  {s | s ∈ K ∧ 0 < s.re ∧ s.re < 1 ∧ riemannZeta (s + ↑t * I) = 0}.Finite
'MasulloGRH.genuineNormTwistZeta_zeros_compact_finite' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'MasulloGRH.genuineNormTwistZeta_zeros_compact_finite' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
MasulloGRH.genuineNormTwistZeta_zeros_compact_finite (t : ℝ) (K : Set ℂ) (hK : IsCompact K) :
  {s | s ∈ K ∧ 0 < s.re ∧ s.re < 1 ∧ riemannZeta (s + ↑t * I) = 0}.Finite
